name: Li the Dashing General
source:
In the fifth year of Chongzhen's reign, a rebel leader came to Jin from Shaanxi and called himself "Li the Dashing General".
His real name is [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Li_Zicheng]Li Zicheng[/url].
